flowContents.comments: Self-healing test pack: Faults among 24 sibling groups. Built by flows/build_all.py.
flowContents.name: nfh-p23-siblings

processGroups.comments: The drain is scheduled every 10 seconds, so it is idle most of the time. (symptom: backlog)
processGroups.name: S51 Slow Run Schedule Among Siblings

processGroups.comments: The validator's failure relationship is auto-terminated, so rejected records disappear. (symptom: data_loss)
processGroups.name: S52 Auto-terminated Failures Among Siblings

processGroups.comments: Lane 3's tokenizer is disabled: the lane backs up into the balancer's queue for it, and the payments balanced to it before it filled are stranded there. (symptom: backpressure)
processGroups.name: S53 Stopped Lane Among Siblings
